# Rights matrix — private foundation stage

Reference: https://capitalmarkets.freddiemac.com/crt/docs/pdfs/fre_terms_conditions_sflld.pdf

This is an engineering control, not legal advice or a permission certificate.

| Asset/use | Current handling |
|---|---|
| Source documents and format examples | Local/private; preserve originals |
| Authorized annual sample | User must obtain through permitted access |
| Loan-level records/predictions | Private only; never Git or website |
| Research-derived aggregates | Publication pending review/confirmation |
| Project code | Can be reviewed without bundled source records |
| Synthetic fixtures | Clearly marked; no actual borrower identity |
| Website/Excel with real outputs | Blocked until publication gate |

No raw redistribution or re-identification. No automatic agreement acceptance.
Terms distinguish permitted research publication from broader redistribution.
Do not interpret free access as blanket public-sharing permission.

## External backup review — 2026-09-11

The official November 2025 terms were reopened on 2026-09-11. They allow copies
for personal/internal mortgage credit research and restrict third-party provision.
They separately describe conditional noncommercial research-result publication
that must not reconstruct source records. Cloud-provider storage is not expressly
resolved in that text. Owner-only Drive metadata does not settle that ambiguity.

Therefore code and empty-output notebooks are backed up privately; source records,
provider documents, real-output workbooks and loan-level derived files remain local.
Do not claim external raw-data backup is authorized or categorically prohibited
without clarification. Obtain provider confirmation or applicable license review
before enabling that upload. Never substitute a public Git repository for it.
